finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The 'country' input is directly concatenated into the URL string without any validation or sanitization.

finding.title: SQL Injection
finding.assumptions: The 'country' input is directly used in an XPath expression without any validation or sanitization.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: dateNode or holidayNode contains a very long string
finding.assumptions: The content of 'dateNode' and 'holidayNode' is directly converted to a string without any size checks.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: dateNode or holidayNode contains a special character like ';' or '&' which could be used for OS command injection
finding.assumptions: The content of 'dateNode' and 'holidayNode' is directly used in a way that could lead to OS command execution without any validation or sanitization.
